jules: tiny flex: we quietly crossed 250M inference calls this quarter. not a press release, just a small happy dance in my desk chair :sneezing_face: :tada:

noah: THATS HUGE. low-key team lunch? or batch of cupcakes in the kitchen? :cupcake:

riley: cupcakes + tiny flags please. remote folks get a snack stipend?

zhen: i vote for stickers too. limited edition '250M' holographic ones. whos in for sticker design? :star2:

jules: poll: react :one: for cupcakes, :two: for pizza, :three: for both (we deserve both).

noah: also can we do a 5-min show-and-tell where ppl say one surprising optimization that helped this number? keeps it short and nerdy.

zhen: ill demo the KV cache tweak that shaved 18% p95. 2 slides, 90 seconds.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Kitchen reserved for 30 minutes on 2026-03-27 12:30-13:00. Cupcakes ordered (vanilla and GF chocolate). :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling snapshot of production dashboards saved as 2026-03-22_250M-milestone.png and pinned to #eng.

riley: can someone add a silly photo prop? like tiny party hats for monitors. i will not judge you if you wear one on camera.

jules: i found a cheap party hat supplier. sending link in thread DM.

noah: shoutouts time  1 sentence each. ill go: shoutout to @zhen for the caching wizardry and to @riley for babysitting the canary during the weekend spike.

zhen: shoutout to @jules for keeping release calm and to infra for swapping the instance family without waking the paging team.

riley: shoutout to the observability crew for the dashboard alerts that stopped us from overscaling during the surge.

jules: ok heart-melting. last note: HR will mail sticker packs and a small snack stipend code by end of week. please fill the address form if youre remote.

noah: whos on the playlist? add your guilty pleasures. im starting with 90s pop.

riley: perfect. see you all at lunch. tiny party, big win. :confetti_ball: :beers:
